nodes.text: You came recommended by the registry, which is the only recommendation I read. Here's the work: brigands are camped on the open road again. My grandfather's grandfather saw the ford chained once. We don't do that twice.

choices.text: Why me and not the watch?
I'm not ready for crown work.

nodes.text: The watch holds walls. Roads need someone who walks them anyway. That's you, or I've read the registry wrong.
Camps first, archers included. Then whoever keeps their shares. There's always one. The Crown pays when the road is quiet, not before.
Honest answer. Come back when you are.
